question: What appearance and ritual effect are associated with the molten-gold radiant form?
premises: The form has the splendor of molten gold.
It is described as a cause of agitation of cities and similar effects.
Appearance and effect are attributed to the same form.
inference: The molten-gold radiant form is used as a cause for agitating cities and related purposes.
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is the cause of agitating cities and the like.
